question: Get full names and emails of users.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT full_name, email FROM users;

question: Get id and title of movies.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT movies.id, movies.title FROM movies;

question: List movies and their genres.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, g.name FROM movies m JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.id = mg.movie_id JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.id;

question: List movies and their actors.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, a.full_name FROM movies m JOIN movie_actors ma ON m.id = ma.movie_id JOIN actors a ON ma.actor_id = a.id;

question: List movies and their directors.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, d.full_name FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id;

question: Show reviews with user names.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT users.full_name, reviews.* FROM reviews JOIN users ON reviews.user_id = users.id;

question: List reviews with movie titles.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT movies.title, reviews.* FROM movies JOIN reviews ON movies.id = reviews.movie_id;

question: List users and their favorite movies.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT u.full_name, m.title FROM favorites f JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id JOIN movies m ON f.movie_id = m.id;

question: List movies in the Action genre.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.id = mg.movie_id JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'Action';

question: List movies directed by directors from USA.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE d.country = 'USA';

question: List actors in movie with id = 1.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT a.full_name FROM movie_actors ma JOIN actors a ON ma.actor_id = a.id WHERE ma.movie_id = 1;

question: List movies with actor named 'Leonardo DiCaprio'.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.* FROM movies m JOIN movie_actors ma ON m.id = ma.movie_id WHERE ma.actor_id = (SELECT a.id FROM actors a WHERE a.full_name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio');

question: List movies with more than one genre.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.id = mg.movie_id GROUP BY m.id HAVING COUNT(mg.genre_id) > 1;

question: List movies with at least one review.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.title FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id;

question: List movies without any reviews.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m LEFT JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id WHERE r.id IS NULL;

question: List users who have not reviewed any movies.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT `users`.`id`, `users`.`full_name` FROM `users` LEFT JOIN `reviews` ON `users`.`id` = `reviews`.`user_id` WHERE `reviews`.`movie_id` IS NULL;

question: List actors and their roles.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT actors.full_name, movie_actors.role_name FROM actors JOIN movie_actors ON actors.id = movie_actors.actor_id;

question: List movies with review rating above 9.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM movies JOIN reviews ON movies.id = reviews.movie_id WHERE reviews.rating > 9;

question: List movies sorted by number of favorites.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, COUNT(f.user_id) AS fav_count FROM movies m JOIN favorites f ON m.id = f.movie_id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY fav_count DESC;

question: Count number of movies per genre.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(mg.movie_id) FROM genres g JOIN movie_genres mg ON g.id = mg.genre_id GROUP BY g.id;

question: Count number of reviews per movie.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, COUNT(r.id) FROM movies m LEFT JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id;

question: Count number of movies per director.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.full_name, COUNT(md.movie_id) FROM directors d JOIN movie_directors md ON d.id = md.director_id GROUP BY d.id;

question: Count total number of movies.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies;

question: Count total number of users.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;

question: Calculate average avg_rating of all movies.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(avg_rating) FROM movies;

question: Find movie with highest avg_rating.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM movies WHERE avg_rating = (SELECT MAX(avg_rating) FROM movies);

question: Find movie with longest duration.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM movies WHERE duration_minutes = (SELECT MAX(duration_minutes) FROM movies);

question: Find earliest release year.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MIN(release_year) FROM movies;

question: Count number of reviews per user.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(r.id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN reviews r ON u.id = r.user_id GROUP BY u.id;

question: Calculate average review rating per movie.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title, AVG(r.rating) FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id;

question: Find movie with most reviews.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Count number of movies by country.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT `country`, COUNT(`movies`.`id`) as total FROM `movies` GROUP BY `country`;
